dependency_edges.handoff: SSDM price and cost mechanisms are used to interpret fitted CM coefficients
electricity margin and oil/resource consequences motivate the energy-flow LP
vehicle competition and type-dependent development motivate environmental and resource analysis
the unconstrained LP exposes an impossible source mix that triggers constraint repair
the repaired LP is rerun across efficiency and vehicle-type conditions
tax and capacity results become government recommendations
a0 mechanisms become infrastructure and technology recommendations
eta threshold and type rankings become conditional government and manufacturer advice
